LanguageData.Plant_WaterLily.label: water lily
LanguageData.Plant_WaterLily.description: A cultivated aquatic flower with broad floating leaves and a pale blossom. It is grown for beauty rather than for food.
LanguageData.Plant_Glowreed.label: glowreed
LanguageData.Plant_Glowreed.description: A bioluminescent aquatic reed that stores daylight and emits a faint glow after dark. More mature plants shine brighter.
